subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Behavioral Profiling
description: Learn Behavioral Profiling in one minute.

hook.text: You scrolled past that ad in 0.3 seconds. You paused on this one for 4 seconds. The algorithm noticed both.

buildup.text: Platforms track not just what you click, but how long you look, where you pause, and what makes you scroll faster.

discovery.text: This micro-behavioral data builds a profile of your emotions, preferences, and vulnerabilities.

twist.text: The platform may know your moods better than your friends do. It certainly reacts to them faster.

climax.text: Every fraction of a second you spend on a post teaches the algorithm something new about who you are.

punchline.text: You scrolled past it. The algorithm still learned.

quiz.question: What kind of data does behavioral profiling collect beyond clicks?
options: Pause duration, scroll speed, and time spent viewing content
